title: InsureReady: cyber-insurance evidence from Microsoft 365, sold through MSPs
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Connects read-only to a company's Microsoft 365 and produces the evidence pack that cyber insurers now ask for. Sold mainly through small IT providers (MSPs), who resell it to their clients.
hook: "The insurer doesn't want a yes anymore. They want proof that MFA is on for every admin, every mailbox and the backups."
story:
**Tom runs a 6-person MSP in Leeds that looks after 35 small businesses' Microsoft 365.** Every few weeks a client's cyber-insurance renewal arrives with a long questionnaire: is MFA enforced for remote access, admin accounts and email? Are legacy logins blocked? Are backups tested? Tom's engineer clicks through each tenant's admin pages and takes screenshots for **hours per client**.

Insurers now check these answers, and claims can be refused if reality does not match the questionnaire. With InsureReady, Tom connects each tenant **read-only once**, and gets a **white-label evidence PDF** mapped to the insurance questions, plus a weekly "what changed" email. He resells it to every client as a renewal service.
whyNow: Insurers have moved from yes/no questions to asking where MFA is enforced, and partial MFA can count as no MFA. Business email compromise and payment fraud made up 58% of incidents in Coalition's 2026 claims report, and the UK's Cyber Essentials version 3.3 tightened MFA rules from 27 April 2026.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: Small MSPs (1–15 staff, 5–60 client Microsoft tenants); second, small businesses with 10–250 staff renewing cyber insurance.

whoPays.label: Buyer
whoPays.text: The MSP owner or technical lead; for direct sales, the office manager or finance lead. Small insurance brokers act as referral partners.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: UK, Nordics, US, Australia and New Zealand, in English.

solution.title: Connect read-only
solution.text: the MSP gives admin consent to a multi-tenant Microsoft Entra app with least-privilege, read-only permissions.

solution.title: Check the tenant
solution.text: MFA registration and enforcement per user and role, Conditional Access, legacy logins, number of global admins, mailbox forwarding rules, stale accounts, Secure Score.

solution.title: Check from the outside
solution.text: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, TLS certificates and exposed remote-desktop ports per domain.

solution.title: Add backup proof
solution.text: upload a backup restore-test record with a timestamp.

solution.title: Fill the questionnaire
solution.text: a standard 30-question insurance questionnaire is answered automatically, each answer linked to evidence.

solution.title: White-label PDF + weekly changes
solution.text: the MSP's logo on the pack, and a weekly "what changed" email.

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Publish a free "M365 cyber-insurance readiness checklist" on r/msp and LinkedIn and count downloads. Jonatan books 15 calls with MSP owners. Victor hand-produces 5 evidence packs for 2–3 MSPs' real client renewals with free tools (Microsoft admin exports, MXToolbox, Shodan). Ask for a $99 pre-order or $10 per client per month. Success = 3 MSPs commit with named clients.
Victor builds the Entra app, Graph checks and external checks.
Questionnaire mapping, white-label PDF, weekly change email, published security documentation.
Pilot MSPs run real renewals; collect testimonials for r/msp and MSPGeek.

risks.risk: MSPs may not trust a young vendor with admin consent
risks.answer: Least-privilege, read-only permissions; publish security documentation and a clear data policy.

risks.risk: Microsoft API changes; CIPP adds a similar free report
risks.answer: Focus on the insurance mapping and the client-ready PDF, not raw data.

risks.risk: Each insurer uses a different form
risks.answer: Start with one standard 30-question set and add insurer mappings as customers ask.

risks.risk: Liability if an answer in the pack is wrong
risks.answer: Every answer links to evidence; the MSP reviews and signs off before sending.
